notice: This register audits the NO-GO prototype. Every gap is open or blocked, every evidence reference is null, and every milestone is a planning target with no launch date. It does not close a gate, provide production evidence or grant launch approval.

gaps.title: Production identity provider and hardware MFA enrolment
gaps.description: Production IdP, phishing-resistant hardware-backed MFA and named individual Admin accounts are not attached; the local seeded admin identity is generated, local-only and not a production account.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Hosted IdP configuration, hardware MFA enrolment record for named individuals, server-derived role assignment and a distinct approval record.

gaps.title: Immutable external audit sink, retention and alert routing
gaps.description: Local admin actions are append-only, but no external immutable sink, WORM-equivalent schedule or login/mutation alert routing is configured.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: External append-only sink configuration, dated WORM retention schedule, alert routing proof and a tested replay/reconciliation report.

gaps.title: Penetration test and independent security audit
gaps.description: No penetration test, threat-model review or independent security audit result is attached; hosted scans are Phase 1 gate-parity evidence only.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Dated penetration test report, remediation verification and an independent security audit opinion with named assessors.

gaps.title: Tenant isolation, key custody and transport evidence
gaps.description: No staging or production cross-tenant RLS test run, KMS custody record, at-rest encryption or TLS configuration evidence is attached.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Cross-tenant RLS test output against a non-local database, KMS custody record, encryption configuration and TLS proof.

gaps.title: Open hosted image advisories including shadow CVE
gaps.description: Hosted scanning shows 22 open image findings with zero critical; the two unscored CVE-2026-135901 / DSA-6661-1 shadow alerts remain open and are not waived.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Refreshed digest-pinned base image with shadow at 1:4.17.4-2+deb13u1 or later plus a hosted rescan recording closure of all open findings.

gaps.title: Launch manifest approvals and guard removal record
gaps.description: Legal approver, compliance approver and guard-removal approval fields are null in the launch manifest and jurisdiction clearance register.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Signed, distinct legal and compliance approval records with effective dates plus a reviewed production guard replacement decision.

gaps.title: Jurisdiction licensing owners, counsel and tax rules
gaps.description: All 17 jurisdiction records have null licensing owner, effective date, counsel review and tax rule references; six regulated activity counsel records are also null.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Per-jurisdiction licensing owner, effective date, counsel opinion reference and dated tax rule source for every enabled market.

gaps.title: Commercial licence domains remain unobtained
gaps.description: All six commercial licence domains are not_obtained with null evidence refs: alcohol retail, fulfilment, tax registration, payment processing, custody and distribution.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Dated licence or regulator evidence for each commercial domain required by the enabled markets, with named holders and expiry tracking.

gaps.title: Vault legal opinions and custody protections
gaps.description: All five Vault legal reviews are not_obtained; no securities advice, title/fractional interest, custody licence, AML/sanctions/tax or consumer protection opinion is attached.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Five signed legal opinions with named owners, jurisdictions and effective dates; custody and investor protection evidence for any live Vault feature.

gaps.title: DPIA, lawful bases and signed processing record
gaps.description: No DPIA is completed; all 15 lawful bases are design targets with null evidence and no signed record of processing is attached.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Completed DPIA, evidence-backed lawful basis register and a signed record of processing activities with named owner and review date.

gaps.title: Retention, deletion and crypto-shredding jobs
gaps.description: No scheduled retention job, deletion worker, crypto-shredding integration or legal-hold model is implemented; schedules are design targets only.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Executed retention and deletion job records, downstream propagation proof, legal-hold test and crypto-shredding integration evidence.

gaps.title: Consent receipts, withdrawal propagation and DSAR execution
gaps.description: Prototype consent and DSAR flows are simulated; no production consent receipt, downstream withdrawal propagation or executed erasure/export exists.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Production consent receipts with timestamps, withdrawal propagation trace and an executed DSAR run with verified downstream effects.

gaps.title: Cross-border transfer mechanism and processor agreements
gaps.description: No transfer impact assessment, approved cross-border mechanism, processor agreement or subprocessor list is attached.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Approved transfer impact assessment, mechanism record and signed processor/subprocessor agreements with effective dates.

gaps.title: Load, stress, soak, canary and chaos results
gaps.description: All six test plans remain planned with null evidence; every route p95/p99 measured field is null and only a sequential loopback baseline exists.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Executed load, stress, soak, failure injection, canary and chaos reports with source-derived pass/skip/fail counts and measured p95/p99 by route.

gaps.title: SLO pipeline, error budget and status history
gaps.description: No SLO measurement pipeline, error-budget burn report, external status page, deployment history or uptime history is attached.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Live SLO measurement output, dated error-budget report, external status page reference and uptime/deployment history.

gaps.title: Distributed rate limiting and log redaction
gaps.description: Local rate limiting and log hygiene are prototype-scope; no distributed limiter or structured log redaction evidence is attached.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Distributed rate-limit configuration with measured enforcement and structured log samples proving secret redaction.

gaps.title: Browser-flow CI coverage
gaps.description: Browser self-test runs locally but no hosted browser-flow CI result is attached; the register records this as an outstanding gap.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Hosted workflow result running the browser flow with generated pass/skip/fail counts on a release candidate commit.

gaps.title: Production backup, PITR, failover, RTO and RPO
gaps.description: Only a local logical restore drill exists with a null production ref; no production backup, PITR, offsite copy, failover or RTO/RPO measurement is attached.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Production backup configuration, PITR restore record, offsite or immutable copy proof, failover drill and measured RTO/RPO with named approver.

gaps.title: Migration role separation, staging run and licensed data
gaps.description: No dedicated production migration role, staging migration run or representative licensed-data validation is attached.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Production migration role evidence, reviewed staging run record and licensed-data validation report with checksums.

gaps.title: Container startup and signed release artifact
gaps.description: Full container startup remains unverified locally and the release workflow has produced no signed artifact in this workspace.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Container build/startup record from the pinned image, cosign signature, checksum verification and an immutable SBOM/scan bundle for the promoted artifact.

gaps.title: Promotion decision record and launch gate evidence
gaps.description: The launch-approval release stage has a null hosted evidence ref; promotionAllowed is false and no promotion decision record exists.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Distinct executive, compliance and operations approval records, a dated promotion decision and a hosted release-stage result.

gaps.title: Named reviewers and enforced repository controls
gaps.description: No named individual holds owner or approver roles; enforce_admins is false, no GitHub DCO app or independent reviewer is configured.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Named owner/approver register, enabled admin enforcement, configured DCO app and independent reviewer approval on the promotion commit.

gaps.title: Architecture review and signed deliverable records
gaps.description: No hosted Architecture Review Board approval or signed deliverable review is attached; all ADRs remain prototype-scope only.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Hosted ARB approval record, signed deliverable review signatures and ADRs with production-scope evidence where applicable.

gaps.title: Agent kill-switch drill and adversarial evidence
gaps.description: No timed agent kill-switch drill under 60 seconds, sandbox/canary/replay run or prompt-injection red-team result is attached; execution stays disabled.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Timed kill-switch drill under 60 seconds, sandbox/canary/replay records, red-team report and distinct high-impact tool review.

gaps.title: Model evaluation gates and retained AI logs
gaps.description: No offline evaluation result, human-reviewed model/prompt promotion record, production retrieval log sink or licensed safety classifier is attached.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Evaluation results with thresholds, distinct human promotion approval, retained prompt/model/retrieval logs and licensed safety classifier evidence.

gaps.title: Licensed payment, ledger and dispute workflows
gaps.description: No licensed PSP, PCI scope review, double-entry ledger, settlement reconciliation or dispute workflow is integrated; payments are simulated.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Licensed PSP agreement, PCI scope review, ledger and reconciliation test results, idempotency verification and executed dispute workflow.

gaps.title: Age, KYC, AML and sanctions provider integration
gaps.description: No certified age/KYC provider, official sanctions/PEP/AML list, signature verification or delivery age-check integration exists; six age fraud scenarios are simulated.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Provider due diligence, signed jurisdiction age rules, official screening feed, delivery age proof and executed fraud scenario suite.

gaps.title: Licensed catalogue and verified inventory
gaps.description: The served catalogue is 12 labelled demo rows with zero licensed feeds and zero verified rows; no supplier contract or rights evidence is attached.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Licensed feed agreements, verified row counts, rights and provenance evidence, supplier contracts and pricing/tax source records.

gaps.title: External marketing execution and alcohol-ad validation
gaps.description: No ad platform or email connector, live spend cap, jurisdiction alcohol-advertising validation, immutable audit sink or kill-switch drill result is attached.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Sandbox connector validation, alcohol-advertising counsel approval, budget-owner record, immutable audit proof and executed pause/rollback/kill-switch drill.

gaps.title: Pricing counsel, human approvals and disparity testing
gaps.description: Competition/consumer pricing and alcohol-promotion counsel opinions are not obtained; no human-approved published change or measured disparity result is attached.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Dated counsel opinions, distinct human approval record, explainability evidence and measured geographic/demographic disparity results.

gaps.title: Responsible-drinking review and measured outcomes
gaps.description: No licensed harm classifier, clinical/minors policy review, measured velocity or complaint outcome, delivery proof or immutable event sink is attached.
gaps.acceptanceEvidence: Clinical and minors policy review, measured velocity/complaint outcomes, localised support resources and immutable screening event records.

timeline.note: All windows are relative planning targets, not committed dates. No launch date is set, and no phase may start until its entry criteria are evidenced and reviewed.

phases.objective: Close every blocking gap with independent evidence and prepare a signed promotion decision package.
entryCriteria: Verdict is NO-GO and promotionAllowed is false
This register has been reviewed with four-eyes and all gap evidence refs remain null

milestones.title: Audit baseline accepted by four-eyes review
milestones.exitCriteria: All 31 gaps are open or blocked with a named owner role and null evidence refs; a distinct reviewer records acceptance.

milestones.title: Legal, jurisdiction and licence clearance pack
milestones.exitCriteria: Launch approvals, per-jurisdiction counsel/tax records, commercial licences, Vault opinions and licensed catalogue rights are attached and dated.

milestones.title: Security and identity control evidence
milestones.exitCriteria: IdP/MFA enrolment, immutable audit, penetration test, RLS/KMS/TLS evidence, advisory closure and distributed limits are attached.

milestones.title: Privacy and data lifecycle evidence
milestones.exitCriteria: DPIA, lawful bases, retention jobs, consent receipts, withdrawal propagation, DSAR run and transfer mechanism are evidenced.

milestones.title: Reliability, migration and disaster-recovery evidence
milestones.exitCriteria: All six test plans are executed with measured p95/p99, browser-flow CI is green, backup/PITR/failover and role separation are evidenced.

milestones.title: Commerce, AI and marketing control evidence
milestones.exitCriteria: Payments, age/KYC, agent and model gates, marketing execution controls and pricing/disparity reviews carry distinct approvals.

milestones.title: Repository governance and named ownership
milestones.exitCriteria: Named owners, enforced admin checks, DCO app, independent reviewer, ARB approval and signed deliverable reviews are attached.

milestones.title: Promotion decision package prepared
milestones.exitCriteria: A four-eyes promotion package records every gap as evidenced or explicitly accepted as a blocking no-go, with the launch-approval stage still null until signed.

phases.objective: Execute a controlled, reversible exposure only after the pre-launch exit criteria and explicit promotion decision are evidenced.
entryCriteria: Signed promotion decision and launch-approval stage evidence exist

milestones.title: Change freeze and signed artifact verification
milestones.exitCriteria: Pinned image digest, cosign signature, checksums, SBOM and scan bundle are verified against the promoted commit under change freeze.

milestones.title: Staged exposure with live SLO monitoring
milestones.exitCriteria: Staged rollout, measured p95/p99, error-budget burn and rollback thresholds are observed and recorded at each stage.

milestones.title: Incident command, support rota and rollback readiness
milestones.exitCriteria: On-call rota, monitored reporting channel, alert routing and a rehearsed rollback path are active with named contacts.

phases.objective: Review measured outcomes, reconcile audit and incidents, and close the evidence register before any maturity reassessment.
entryCriteria: M-LW-02 and M-LW-03 exit criteria are evidenced
No unresolved critical incident remains open

milestones.title: Stabilisation review and error-budget report
milestones.exitCriteria: A dated stabilisation report records measured availability, p95/p99 by route, error-budget burn and any threshold breach.

milestones.title: Post-incident and audit reconciliation review
milestones.exitCriteria: Incident reviews, break-glass/post-incident records and immutable audit reconciliation are attached with named reviewers.

milestones.title: Evidence closure and maturity reassessment
milestones.exitCriteria: Every gap is closed with evidence or explicitly reopened; any lifecycle-state change passes four-eyes and never relies on documentation alone.

evidentiaryBoundary: Hosted green checks prove Phase 1 gate parity only; local drill, baseline and Admin walkthrough evidence is prototype-only. No milestone is complete until independent evidence is attached. This audit is not a penetration test, security audit, DPIA, counsel opinion, compliance certificate, production DR result, signed release or launch approval.
evidenceGaps: No launch date or launch approval is set; all timeline windows are relative planning targets.
No owner is a named individual signature; role assignments are accountability labels until reviewed and signed.
No gap evidence reference is attached; a null reference remains an explicit gap.
